candidate.text: The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`) have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18. Cilium CLI should be used to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.

evidence.excerpt:
* The flag `k8s-mode` (and related flags `cilium-agent-container-name`, `k8s-namespace` & `k8s-label`)
  have been deprecated and will be removed in a Cilium 1.18. Cilium CLI should be used to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster.
